name: illustrator-import-image-prototype
description: Prototype tool to open Adobe Illustrator and import a selected image.

scripts.start: chcp 65001>nul&& set ACRYLIC_CHECKPOINT_ITEM_LIMIT=90&& set ACRYLIC_CHECKPOINT_MODE=continue&& set ACRYLIC_CHECKPOINT_PAUSE_MS=0&& set ACRYLIC_JSX_BATCH_SIZE=18&& set ACRYLIC_ITEM_STALL_TIMEOUT_MS=180000&& set ACRYLIC_QUIT_ILLUSTRATOR_AFTER_SAVE=0&& set ACRYLIC_CLOSE_DOCUMENT_AFTER_SAVE=1&& npm run build && node dist-bundle/index.cjs
scripts.error: chcp 65001>nul&& set ACRYLIC_IGNORE_CHECK_FALSE=1&& set ACRYLIC_ERROR_COMPARE_ONLY=1&& set ACRYLIC_SKIP_DERIVED_OUTPUT_EXPORT=1&& set ACRYLIC_CHECKPOINT_ITEM_LIMIT=90&& set ACRYLIC_CHECKPOINT_MODE=continue&& set ACRYLIC_CHECKPOINT_PAUSE_MS=0&& set ACRYLIC_JSX_BATCH_SIZE=1&& set ACRYLIC_ITEM_STALL_TIMEOUT_MS=180000&& set ACRYLIC_QUIT_ILLUSTRATOR_AFTER_SAVE=0&& set ACRYLIC_CLOSE_DOCUMENT_AFTER_SAVE=1&& npm run build && node dist-bundle/index.cjs
scripts.check: chcp 65001>nul&& set ACRYLIC_CHECK_FULL_PIPELINE=1&& set ACRYLIC_JSX_BATCH_SIZE=1&& set ACRYLIC_ITEM_STALL_TIMEOUT_MS=180000&& set ACRYLIC_QUIT_ILLUSTRATOR_AFTER_SAVE=0&& set ACRYLIC_CLOSE_DOCUMENT_AFTER_SAVE=1&& npm run build && node dist-bundle/index.cjs
scripts.debug:lazer: set ACRYLIC_DEBUG_LAZER_STEPS=1&& npm run build && node dist-bundle/index.cjs
scripts.debug: set ACRYLIC_DEBUG_PIPELINE=1&& npm run build && node dist-bundle/index.cjs
